description: Electricity and Gas - Origin from January 2023 (Hawkesbury City Council) is a dataset listed in Hawkesbury City open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Hawkesbury City Council. Electricity and Gas usage data from Council's operations. Coverage: Hawkesbury, New South Wales. The portal files it under Environmental Protection. Its keywords are Sustainability Dashboard, Electricity, gas, energy, Sustainability & Net Zero dashboard. The portal shows 1,143 records. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal shows 2026-09-03 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-hawkesbury-nsw-gov-au-portal.
